text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "And the retailer is well on track, having already succeeded in reducing its energy consumption by around 6 percent and its CO2 emissions by more than 20 percent by 2014.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "CO2 neutrality, reduction of absolute energy consumption by 20 percent versus 2008, and increasing the proportion of renewable energy to 80 percent: these are the declared goals Coop aims to achieve by 2023."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Pour cet objectif ambitieux intégré dans une vaste stratégie de développement durable, Coop se voit décerner un prix spécial Watt d'Or 2016 «stratégie d'entreprise».", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Coop was awarded the 2016 Watt d'Or in the special “Corporate strategy” category for these ambitious targets, which are embedded in a comprehensive sustainability strategy."}]}
